name: reunion-pluies-grass
why: A 589 x 294 window of the 25 m BD ALTI DEM over the Riviere des Pluies catchment, Reunion, with the D8 direction, accumulation and catchment GRASS GIS 8.3.2 produced for the same cells. GRASS was written outside this project, so agreement with it is an external cross-implementation check of D8 routing, accumulation and catchment delineation.
citation: Poncet, N. et al. (2026). Flow direction and accumulation maps, streams post-processed from BDAlti 25m DEM on Reunion island + Riviere des Pluies catchment boundaries [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18790150
cut: gdal_translate -of ENVI -srcwin 996 44 294 589 on each GeoTIFF; gdal_rasterize -burn 1 -init 0 -tr 25 25 -te 339562.5 7675437.5 346912.5 7690162.5 on catchment_1.shp (both polygons, value 1, cell-centre rule)
rowOrder: north-to-south: row 0 of z is the northern row of the window, as in the source raster. OpenLiDARViewer's row 0 is the southern row, so a reader reverses the rows before routing. Every row-major index in reference is over z as stored here.
cellMetresNote: EPSG:2975 (RGR92 / UTM zone 40S), 25 m square cells.

reference.versionEvidence: TIFFTAG_SOFTWARE in flow_dir_GRASS.tif and flow_acc_GRASS.tif reads "GRASS GIS 8.3.2 with GDAL 3.8.4".
reference.module: Not named by the dataset. The direction encoding and the signed integer accumulation are those of r.watershed in single-flow mode, a least-cost router.
reference.elevation: z is mnt_filled_GRASS.tif. Despite its name it still holds closed depressions.
reference.drainageEncoding: Row-major over z. k in 1..8 is a direction k x 45 degrees anticlockwise from east (1 NE, 2 N, 3 NW, 4 W, 5 SW, 6 S, 7 SE, 8 E, with north toward row 0 of z). A negative value points the same way and marks flow that leaves the region. -32768 is NoData.
reference.accumulationEncoding: Row-major over z, cells including the cell itself, as integers. A negative value means the upslope area may extend beyond the region. 0 marks NoData.
reference.catchmentEncoding: Row-major over z, 1 inside the rasterised Riviere des Pluies catchment polygon, 0 outside.
reference.mouthCellNote: [row, col] in z as stored: the catchment cell with the largest absolute accumulation (72077 cells), GRASS direction -3.
